name: Pan Yuhao
current_role: Co-founder; last reported (2016) as Chairman & President of Zhen Kung Fu (真功夫) fast-food chain
profile: Pan Yuhai (潘宇海; input romanization 'Pan Yuhao' appears to be a variant) co-founded Zhen Kung Fu, a Guangdong-based Chinese fast-food chain known for steamed dishes. He took over as chairman after co-founder Cai Dabiao's 2011 arrest and in 2016 launched a 'next 25 years' strategy (O2O marketing, supply chain, smart stores). No recent updates found.
interesting_fact: Zhen Kung Fu's in-house developed computer-controlled steam cabinets are credited with solving the 'standardization' problem of Chinese cooking, letting a Chinese chain operate like Western fast food.
deep_cut_fact: In 1990, aged 17, he opened a small dessert shop called the '168 Dessert House' (168甜品屋) in Dongguan, the seed of what became Shuang Zhong Zi and then Zhen Kung Fu.
notes: Chinese name 潘宇海 is romanized Pan Yuhai in most sources; matched via Zhen Kung Fu. Company history includes a well-publicized founder dispute — avoid. At a 2016 launch he joked about being a 'post-70s old cured meat' (老腊肉) — playful persona (https://www.tmtpost.com/1963024.html). Current role not verified after 2016.

name: Khushboo Rajiv Poddar
current_role: Member of the Poddar promoter family of Balkrishna Industries (BKT); role at the company not confirmed in filings
profile: Khushboo Poddar is part of the promoter family behind Balkrishna Industries (BKT), Mumbai-based maker of off-highway tyres for agriculture, construction and mining, chaired by Arvind Poddar with Rajiv Poddar as Joint MD. Her listed wealth stems from the family's BKT shareholding. MarketScreener lists her as a former management-committee member; a media report calls her joint MD, unconfirmed by filings.
interesting_fact: BKT, the source of the family wealth, is a global off-highway tyre specialist serving customers in 163 countries and runs an extensive sports-sponsorship programme.
notes: Very private; almost no public footprint of her own. Board filings name Arvind and Rajiv Poddar, not her. Best route is via BKT corporate channels. Role claim (joint MD) comes only from a tabloid-style DNA India piece — treat as unverified.

name: Karthik Ganapathy
current_role: Co-founder and Vice President, BillDesk (IndiaIdeas.com Ltd), Mumbai
profile: IIT Bombay (EE '93) and IIM Bangalore (MBA '95) graduate who left Arthur Andersen's financial-services consulting practice to co-found BillDesk in 2000 with MN Srinivasu and Ajay Kaushal. BillDesk became India's leading bill-payment gateway; a $4.7bn sale to Prosus/PayU agreed in 2021 was later terminated (2022), and he remains co-founder and VP.
interesting_fact: BillDesk processed over Rs 12 trillion in digital transactions in 2023; when the Prosus deal was announced in 2021, the three co-founders were each expected to receive about $500m for their combined ~30% stake.
deep_cut_fact: Spent ~5 years at Arthur Andersen consulting for banks and brokers before BillDesk; lists tennis and reading as hobbies and his mantra as 'Be yourself, everybody else is already taken.' Fond of his IIT Bombay hostel-council and Mood Indigo days.
notes: Low-profile founder; rarely gives interviews. The Prosus/PayU acquisition was terminated in Oct 2022, so the founders retain their stake. Approach via BillDesk corporate or IIT Bombay / IIM Bangalore alumni networks. Bloomberg 2021 piece on the founders: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-09-02/three-men-pushing-50-reap-millions-selling-india-payments-firm

name: An Ying
profile: Listed on the Hurun China Rich List (2007-2008) with wealth from Orient Group (东方集团), the Harbin-based conglomerate (finance, building-materials retail, Jinzhou port) controlled by founder Zhang Hongwei. No public source found describing An Ying (安英) or her/his role at the group.
interesting_fact: Orient Group, founded in 1978, describes itself as one of China's first private enterprises approved to restructure as a joint-stock company and list (SSE: 600811).
notes: Could not identify this person in Chinese or English sources; may be a former executive/shareholder of Orient Group. Listed company is in financial distress (bank lawsuits 2025) — not a good outreach angle. Recommend skipping unless the journalist has another lead.

name: Jiang Xiong
current_role: Reported as Honorary Chairman, CIMC-TianDa Holdings (formerly China Fire Safety Enterprise Group) — not confirmed by primary filing
profile: Fujian-born entrepreneur who was executive director and largest shareholder (34.4% in 2008) of Hong Kong GEM-listed China Fire Safety Enterprise Group, a fire-protection products maker in which United Technologies held ~29%. The company later came under CIMC and was renamed CIMC-TianDa (airport equipment, fire safety); he is listed as its honorary chairman.
interesting_fact: His fire-protection company counted United Technologies (owner of Kidde/Chubb fire businesses) as its second-largest shareholder, holding 28.9% in 2008.
notes: Identity link (Jiang Xiong of China Fire Safety Enterprise Group = 'Xiong Jiang', honorary chairman CIMC-TianDa) rests on MarketScreener and a 2008 HKEX filing; verify before outreach. Previously active in the World Fujian Youth Association and Fujian Overseas Exchange Association (per MarketScreener). No published contacts found; CIMC-TianDa has been taken private.

name: M Sivakumaran
current_role: Retired; former Whole-time Director of Aurobindo Pharma (stepped down 24 Aug 2023); still listed as director of some Aurobindo group entities
profile: Dr Meenakshisunderam Sivakumaran is an organic chemist who spent about 34 years (1989-2023) as an executive director of Hyderabad-based Aurobindo Pharma, overseeing R&D, new-product development and quality as it grew into one of India's largest generic drugmakers. His wealth stems from his Aurobindo shareholding. He retired from the board in August 2023.
interesting_fact: In his 2023 resignation letter he wrote that 'after careful consideration spanning over several years' he had decided it was time to retire, despite already being past the typical retirement age.
deep_cut_fact: A University of Madras graduate with a doctorate in organic chemistry from Jadavpur University, he was the scientist on Aurobindo's founding-era board credited with leading its R&D and technology development for over three decades.
notes: Retired and very low profile; no personal online presence found. Company IR is only an indirect route. Board change record: https://www.aurobindo.com/investors/corporate-governance/appointment-and-resignation-of-directors
